Just come back from a week in Norfolk which was amazing!

Less amazing that a fuse tripped while we were away, so my mastodon instance - and everything else I self host - has been down for ~ 2.5 days. 

I guess that’s just the risk of self hosting…

On the plus side I met some seals whilst walking along the beach which was absolutely amazing and more than made up for the lack of mastodon!

#SelfHosted #SelfHosting #mastoadmin
